The pause-to-retry amplification loop is fully supported, but the expected next-experiment, connection-capacity and chapter-framing points are largely unaddressed.
Channel-hash routing, single-flight coalescing, transfer risks and the ScyllaDB context are all supported by the cited sections.

The measured-input requirements and validator check are supported, but the expected replay-proof and V12-D calibration points are not addressed.
The four future-work checks and the completed Cases 1-4 match the cited Case 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 sections.
